versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Visual skill, focusing on design and UI enhancement.

- Provides guidance for graphic design, UI/UX, PPT beautification, and brand tone upgrades.
- Introduces screening options like collaboration mode, permission granularity, and cross-device compatibility.
- Specifies detailed return fields such as version history, task progress, and cloud sync status.
- Includes example queries and best practices for data safety and collaboration security.
- Outlines a regular monthly update cycle based on user feedback and software upgrades.
